summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow a 5-year carryback for the low-income housing tax credit, enabling developers to apply current tax credits to tax liabilities from the previous five years.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow a 5-year carryback for the low-income housing tax credit. This change effectively reduces the tax burden for eligible entities by allowing them to apply tax credits to previous tax years, thus lowering their overall tax liability. The bill is entirely focused on this tax provision.
